assertions.assertion: The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope.
The episodes are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring.
The intermittent symptoms need to be correlated with underlying arrhythmias.
The etiology of the collapse needs to be determined.
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated for extended rhythm assessment.
The service at issue is CPT 93271.
The claim was denied under Reason Code CO-97.
The clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the service.
